description: The whole canvas as five outputs — Spaces, Nodes, Segments, Graph, Images (footprints). Each carries every item of its kind. Independent of selection.
instructions:
Emits the WHOLE canvas as five typed outputs — Spaces, Nodes, Segments, Graph, Images (footprints) — each carrying EVERY item of its kind, independent of the current selection. Wire any output into the matching pipeline (e.g. Spaces → Inset, Segments → Mitered Join, Nodes → Bloom).

The input endpoint accepts a Schema node to attach Node / Segment / Graph schema properties to the canvas components; geometry still comes from the canvas (any incoming geometry is ignored).
